title: The varying mass distribution of molecular clouds across M83
question: Does the molecular cloud mass distribution in M83 show a truncation mass that varies with galactocentric radius, like the young massive cluster population?

data.arrays: 12-m dishes only; no total power or short spacings
data.sensitivity: median brightness sensitivity 0.89 K per beam; velocity resolution 2.57 km/s

what.value: Cluster truncation masses, indices and maximum cluster masses per radial bin

evidence.quote: The normalization to equal area bins adopts the binning used in (cite: Adamo_2015) to facilitate direct comparison with that work.

what.value: Disk rotation curve (M_d=6.4e10 Msun, R_d=2.9 kpc)

evidence.quote: the disk mass $M_d=6.4\times 10^{10}~M_{\odot}$, the scale length $R_d=2.9$ kpc
we adopt a CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor of $X_{\mathrm{CO}} = 2.0\times 10^{20}$ (K km s$^{-1}$)$^{-1}$ cm$^{-2}$ (cite: Bolatto_2013)

recipe.method: cprops masking (>2.5 sigma in two adjacent channels, extended to 1 sigma) and seeded watershed decomposition
key_parameters: maxima separated by at least 40 pc or 5.14 km/s; 2.5 sigma above saddle

recipe.method: Inject 350 Gaussian clouds at 51 masses (1e5-1e6 Msun), 10 random offsets; fit logistic recovery function
assumptions: Fake clouds follow Local Group size-linewidth-luminosity relations

recipe.method: Moments with Gaussian correction, beam deconvolution; luminous mass from alpha_CO, virial mass 5 sigma^2 R/G, surface density; bootstrap uncertainties

recipe.goal: Fit cloud mass distributions in radial bins
recipe.method: Fit pure power law, Schechter (beta=-2), truncated power law to completeness-corrected CCDF by minimizing Anderson-Darling statistic, with MCMC for uncertainties
Radial profiles of Sigma, sigma_v from ALMA/SEST CO and THINGS HI; kappa from exponential disk rotation curve; M_J and M_T formulae
assumptions: Exponential disk rotation curve of Lundgren 2004b

evidence.quote: Of the 873 clouds identified, 711 are above the 50% completeness limit.
clouds inside this radius have a median surface density of $\langle \Sigma \rangle = 700~M_{\odot}\mbox{ pc}^{-2}$

answer_key.quantity: Max cluster mass / max cloud mass

evidence.quote: The maximum cluster mass is about 1-2% of the maximum cloud mass.

not_stated_but_needed: Exact imaging parameters of the JVO QA2 cube (weighting, cell size, deconvolver)
CASA version used for the delivered data
Fake-cloud size and line-width parameters used in the injection test
Exact radial bin geometry, inclination and position angle used for deprojection
Method for surface-density and velocity-dispersion profiles in the Toomre/Jeans calculation (radial binning details)
Recipe for the mass-weighted sum of HI and CO dispersions
missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters of the QA2 cube
score_reason: Public data and clear cprops and fitting recipe, but several injection, binning and profile details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: The data are public, the cprops recipe is specified and the main results are numeric (cloud counts, completeness, fitted masses).
